C1360.title: Value DeFi vSwap Flash Loan Attack
C1360.summary: On May 8, 2021, Value DeFi's vSwap AMM non-50/50 liquidity pools were exploited in a flash loan attack, resulting in a loss of approximately $11 million. The attacker borrowed a large amount of assets using a flash loan and targeted a vulnerability in the non-proportional pools, completing the profit within a single transaction.
